description: Pick values out of JSON with a JSONPath expression. Supported: $ (root, optional), .key, ['key'], [0], [-1], [*], .*, ..key (recursive), [start:end:step] slices, unions [0,2] / ['a','b'], and filters like [?(@.price < 10 && @.tags)] (==, !=, <, <=, >, >=, =~ /regex/i, &&, ||, !, .length). Returns each match with its path (the same path style the website's tree view copies, e.g. $.store.book[0].title). Give "text" or a file "path". Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/json-studio/

limit.description: Return at most this many matches (default 1000).

output.description: Optional: write the matched values as a JSON array to this file.

path.description: Or: a path to a JSON file (UTF-8; use this for big inputs).

name: json_query
title: JSON query (JSONPath)
